title: Japanese Pan-Seared Canadian Skillet
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring seared Canadian oysters, sautéed mushrooms, and a hint of warmth.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Canadian oysters and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until they're seared and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the oysters and mushrooms, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional minute, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
